least_degree_convention: minimum max(deg P,deg Q) among exact P/Q interpolants with no pole on the odd norm-one input coset; the first valid interpolant in a deterministic RREF projective basis fixes the reported pole divisor
scope: every ordered row transition of every normalized pairwise-character candidate in prime q in {5,7,11,19,23,31,43}
transition_completion: common label j maps alpha_ij to alpha_lj; the deleted label l maps alpha_il to the inserted value alpha_li
